description: Test vectors of the Boundary payload (docs/reference/signed-config.md 'The payload'; the strict profile of docs/reference/bootstrap-file.md): the payload text, and either what both readers must read from it or the path that a refusal must contain. store@ (Rust, actors/store/tests/vectors.rs) and key@ (Go, actors/key/internal/keyd/boundary_vectors_test.go) read the same file: key@ takes the environment of the floor of the software key driver from the bytes it verified.

cases.name: the local Boundary source
cases.payload:
# The Boundary document of the local installation (ADR 0005, "The snapshot"): the boundary `dev`
# and the config kinds it declares. The harness signs this file as boundary.jws into the
# directory of the `file` driver; the payload is this file, byte for byte.
# One mapping from item id to item; a singleton kind has the one item `default` (decision D-17).
default:
  name: dev
  kind: environment
  level: L2
  environment: development
  issuer: https://sluis.dev.local.test
  uid_block: 0
  default_tenant: acme
  declared_kinds:
    - KeyPlan
    - TokenLifetime
    - GrantVocabulary
    - Policy
    - AuditLog
    - AuditCatalogue
    - Upstream
    - InstallationClient
    - ExchangeTrust
